answer: Hold every identity to Draper serge standard lodged with the drapers charter. The holding costs 2-year apprenticeship, 373 supervised serges, guild exam, 62 POA annual fee, renewal, and the farm holds a hundred of them. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 479 fakes need 479, at 107 POA each, totalling 51253 POA. The whisper is the credential, the plume is the bond, and the wharf is the clock that watches both. An agent earns the seat once; a farm must earn it a hundred times over.
